name: sandbox-bot
description: A private bot to exercise @azurioh/discord-kernel by hand on a test guild. Never published.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:kernel && tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env src/main.ts | pino-pretty
scripts.dev:watch: pnpm run build:kernel && tsx watch --env-file-if-exists=.env src/main.ts | pino-pretty
scripts.register: pnpm run build:kernel && tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env src/register.ts | pino-pretty
